'''Chronerva''' is a [[Grass]] type [[Support]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Tikowl]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Hypnostrix]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Chronerva claims to be able to freeze time. Just look at Souverelle who falls still as soon as the chanting starts. Now thats a powerful, intelligent Tatari if you ask me!"

Chronerva is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
Chronerva is a green, white, and yellow griffin creature with a golden pendulum for a tail that dangles over its head.

Chronerva's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces its green feathers with pink. 

== Evolution Trial ==
Chronerva's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Hypnostrix]] you need to complete the following three tasks:
* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* Shoot 60,000 pinballs.
* Own 24-Star Grass Tatari x3.

== Trivia ==
* Chronerva and its evolutions were added to the game on 5/12/2026 alongside [[Pandagrand]] and [[Sealord]].
